summary: The engineering discipline lands consistently across core and dist, but a shipped reviewer prompt points at a reference file that does not exist, the code-writing roles restate rule content the spec forbids them from restating inline, the plan's ENG-10 reason table omits the largest new file groups on the branch, and several new sentences break the constitution's one-idea-per-sentence writing standard.

findings.summary: The spec-conformance reviewer is pointed at `<F>/references/commit-body.md`, a file that does not exist in the shipped skill.
findings.evidence: Line 20: '...rests on the two accepted `Red:` forms in [commit-body](<F>/references/commit-body.md)'. `core/skills/factory/references/` contains only engineering.md, findings.md, protocol.md, state.md, verbs.md — no commit-body.md — and the same dead link is rendered into dist/claude-code, dist/opencode, dist/codex and dist/copilot skill/roles/spec-conformance.md line 13. The contract it means lives only at specs/001-tdd-engineering-rules/contracts/commit-body.md, a per-feature artifact the plan itself calls 'not part of the shipped instruction set'. A spawned reviewer in any future run hits a dead pointer; constitution IV requires everything an agent needs to be readable from disk in a single spawn.
findings.fix: Change the link to `<F>/references/engineering.md` (its 'Red proof' section already carries the two accepted forms and the separator rule), re-render all four harnesses, and commit dist/ with the source per constitution III.

findings.summary: The code-writing roles restate engineering-rule content inline, violating the feature's own single-source requirement (FR-001, SC-004, DESIGN.md, constitution I).
findings.evidence: FR-001: 'The factory MUST hold its engineering rules in one shared, harness-neutral reference file; no role restates them inline'; SC-004: 'zero inline restatements'; DESIGN.md line 120: roles 'point at it and restates no rule inline'. Yet code-build.md line 17 restates ENG-1 ('write or extend a test, run it and observe it fail before any implementation code, then the smallest code that passes, then refactor only while tests are green and re-run them') and ENG-6 with its definition; line 22 restates ENG-3 ('Commit each task once... no separate red commit'); lines 23-25 restate the ENG-2 red-proof contract ('No other wording counts'), ENG-4 and ENG-5, plus the un-runnable-command definition from engineering.md's own Definitions section. fixer.md lines 17-19 repeat the same set. review-judge.md line 19 restates the full ENG-7..ENG-10 ceiling in the same sentence that ends 'do not restate them'. A future edit to engineering.md now has to be mirrored in up to six role prompts or the copies drift — the exact failure ADR 0001 and SC-004 exist to prevent. The run's own T013/T014 commits claim 'Rules exist once' and 'no rule content restated'; those self-checks were wrong.
findings.fix: In code-build.md, fixer.md and review-judge.md keep only the stage wiring (that the reference is followed, when to stop and what to return, commit subject/Red-line placement), trim duplicated rule content to citations like 'per ENG-1..ENG-3', and re-render dist/. Alternatively amend DESIGN.md line 120 to permit paraphrase — but DESIGN.md is the source of truth, so the roles are the side that must move per constitution I.

findings.summary: The plan's ENG-10 reason table omits the two largest groups of new files the branch adds: the `.specify/` tree and the `.claude/skills/speckit-*` skills.
findings.evidence: 'Reasons for new files, abstractions and dependencies (ENG-10, FR-020b)' (plan.md lines 60-71) lists engineering.md, the four dist copies, CONTEXT.md/ADRs and the spec artifacts — but the branch adds ~60 files under `.specify/` (extensions, scripts, templates, ~8k lines) and 17 files under `.claude/skills/speckit-*`, none with a stated reason. Constitution V: 'A new file, field or verb needs a stated reason in the plan'; FR-020b requires a reason for each new file the plan introduces. The excuse exists (SpecKit's `specify init` generates them, per DESIGN.md 'Missing .specify/' setup step) but the plan never states it, and Scale/Scope ('1 new reference file...') miscounts them as zero.
findings.fix: Add one reason line to the table covering `.specify/` and `.claude/skills/speckit-*` as specify-init tooling required by the factory's SpecKit precondition (DESIGN.md Setup), and correct the Scale/Scope counts.

findings.summary: Several new sentences pack multiple ideas, against the constitution's Writing Standards ('short, imperative and unambiguous: one idea per sentence').
findings.evidence: fixer.md line 17 is one ~80-word sentence carrying three ideas (verdict-driven rounds leave advisory findings, user-changes rounds implement a named advisory finding as asked, user requests keep spec_dir consistent); core/roles/code-standards.md's last paragraph likewise states three rules (style preference exclusion, the MEDIUM ceiling, and 'do not restate') in one sentence; spec-builder.md's analyze override is a similar multi-clause block.
findings.fix: Split the worst offenders into one-idea sentences (the ceiling and the 'do not restate' instruction belong apart in code-standards.md), then re-render dist/.
